clips.title: The story
paras: Charlga Razorflank's medallion lies deep within Razorfen Kraul, carried by the crone who rules the stronghold. Its return gives the night elf sentinels proof that she has fallen.

Charlga Razorflank carries the medallion as the leader of the Razorfen quilboar. At Thalanaar, Falfindel Waywarder learns of fallen explorers such as Heralath and the dwarf Lonebrow, then sends Alliance adventurers against the quilboar leader. The medallion confirms Charlga's death to the night elf sentinels guarding Feralas's borders. They can know that the gathered forces within the Kraul have lost their leader.
